description: Indicadores de atención telefónica EPM is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Empresas Públicas de Medellín. Este conjunto de datos muestra, mes a mes, el comportamiento de la línea de atención telefónica comercial de EPM (604 44 44 115), a través de la cual los usuarios reciben información y gestionan trámites relacionados con los servicios de energía, gas y aguas. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Empresas Públicas de Medellín. Its tags are línea de atención, atención telefónica, epm, servicio al cliente, empresas públicas de medellín. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
